final_message:
I resubmitted your revised bus essay for Dr. Weiss’s regrade at 9:30 p.m. tonight, ahead of Friday’s deadline. Second Draft confirms it received version v4 (receipt sub-4). The grade currently shown is for your earlier draft.

I marked the comments on your opening and both comma splices as addressed. I saved the five remaining comments in your revision checklist.
